IS 6273 : Part 3 : Sec 1 : 2025 Sensory Evaluation of Foods - Guide - Part 3 Statistical Analysis of Data - Section 1 Difference/Preference Tests
ICS 67.240
ICS 67.240
FAD 28
FAD 28
1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 3/Sec 1) covers difference/preference tests. The various tests included in this standard are paired comparison test, duo-trio test, triangle test, normal test, preference matrix analysis and χ²-test.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
